no_api_findings.finding: The scoped standard library documents byte and stream I/O (<fstream>, <istream>, std::byte, <span>) but no MPEG audio frame-header parser or Layer III decoder. Generic reads return bytes without interpreting sync words, bitrate or sample-rate indices, side information or main data.

limit: This covers the documented ISO C++ standard library only. POSIX, platform media frameworks (AVFoundation, Media Foundation, GStreamer) and Boost were not inventoried as standard APIs; TagLib is a third-party package path. It matches the C++ finding in data/cpp/mp3_id3v2/standard.json.
